passage.title: Paragraph with errors
paras: the water came up the street faster than anyone expected, by midnight it had reached our door. Mum carryed the photo albums upstairs and i carried the cat. Its strange what you save first. Our neighbours were on there roof waving a torch, we waved back. In the morning the street was a river and our sofa was floating past the window like a boat

blocks.answers: 1 The (capital letter); 2 expected. By (comma splice); 3 carried (spelling); 4 I (capital letter); 5 It's (it is); 6 their roof (their / there); 7 torch. We (comma splice); 8 like a boat. (missing full stop)

head: Error
Fix
rows: say it in full to check
keep one tense in a paragraph

head: Not this
This
rows: Its clear that there plan wont work, the council has ignored they're residents.
It's clear that their plan won't work: the council has ignored its residents.

model.title: Proofread: 'the river rose quickly, people moved upstairs. Its never been this bad there homes were ruined.'

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The river rose quickly. People moved upstairs. It's never been this bad: their homes were ruined.

keywords.def: two sentences joined by only a comma
words that sound alike but differ: their, there, they're
range of vocabulary and sentences with accurate spelling, punctuation and grammar

questions.a: Two short pieces with logged errors found and fixed.

questions.q: Extend: count the errors you found and add them to your log
Stretch: upgrade one sentence for range (a colon, a short sentence or a precise verb)
What is the most efficient way to proofread under time?
options: only check spelling of long words
read once for each of your three logged errors
read the whole paper slowly from the start
questions.a: B) read once for each of your three logged errors. Targeted hunting finds your errors fastest.
